bugs: Invalid asynchronous repair schedulers left the router live with pending repair.
Task-driven and pre-dispatch canonical restoration admitted reentrant commands before repair completed.

before.schedulerFailures: Four cases expected reconciliationFailed but observed live.
before.reentrancyFailures: Both task-driven and input-triggered repair submitted one nested command; expected zero.

fix: Use the shared rejection handler result to reject thenable scheduler returns. Inline delivery, throws and async results all invalidate the retained callback and fault the router.
Hold the dispatch guard throughout canonical restoration and recheck router liveness before reporting success. Restore the prior guard in finally.

firstBrowserRun.failures: Firefox persistence startup failures coincided with ENOSPC saving traces; data volume was 100% full with 175 MiB available.

environmentRecovery.kind: verified git-ignored, non-symlink Rust incremental compiler cache; no compiler was running
environmentRecovery.recovery: Cargo regenerates the cache; source, compiled outputs and diagnostic evidence were preserved.

limits: Scheduler and reentrancy failures are unit-tested with controlled adapter hooks.
This is not a full release qualification or a fix for the separate intermittent WebKit numeric fault.
Native engine instrumentation remained paused; no commit or publication was performed.
